title: 1679 Armenia earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1679 Armenia earthquake", at revision 1366163520, opens: "The 1679 Armenia earthquake took place on June 4 in the Yerevan region of Armenia, then part of the Safavid Iran." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4551791, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Earthquake in West Asia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
